scope.description: Synchronous local protocol-producer and serialization probe in a three-replica configuration.
assumptions: Empty handler state mirrors constructors, with small instance arrays and in-memory peer writers; network startup, UDP IP discovery, listeners, clocks and executor workers are omitted.
Thrifty mode, F=1, durable=false, no concurrency. Recovery invocation at an empty peer is supplied as a local handler stimulus; no timeout-based reachability or distributed consequence is claimed.

basis.prefix: For each fresh case, handlePropose produces instance 0 at its original replica. Delay its outbound preaccepts. startRecoveryForInstance at replica 2 produces a Prepare, which is decoded and delivered to the original replica. handlePrepare constructs and serializes the reply through SendMsg. Decode into the fresh object used by the receive path and sample raw bytes, errors, all relevant fields and unconsumed bytes under single-threaded ownership.
basis.requirement: A successful PrepareReply wire round trip must preserve the producer value ballot associated with its instance and prior phase; recovery compares that value ballot to select prior state.
basis.responsibility: The local PrepareReply serialization boundary between handlePrepare and handlePrepareReply, independently of any claimed quorum or final decision.

comparisons.description: Compare decoded value ballot with producer state observed independently before prepare; include replica-0 control and replica-1 nonzero case.
